la-btrc.form_seen: Business Tax Registration Certificate (online registration checklist)

fields.en: Federal EIN (partnership, corporation, LLC, trust) or SSN (sole proprietor)
fields.zh: 联邦 EIN（合伙、公司、LLC、信托）或 SSN（独资）

fields.en: Business start date in the City of Los Angeles
fields.zh: 在洛杉矶市开始营业日期
联系人姓名、电话及邮箱

destination.evidence: The fastest way to register is online; the paper form may be submitted by email or at a contact center.

la-btrc.notes: A temporary certificate is issued on completion; the permanent BTRC is mailed in 4 to 6 weeks. The first year's tax is paid at renewal. Under $100,000 global gross receipts may qualify for the Small Business Exemption if renewed on time. The online application also flags Police, Fire or Tobacco permits.

lac-plan-check.form_seen: Retail Food Facility Plan Check Application (electronic submittal)

fields.en: Name and address of the site or project
fields.zh: 项目或场所名称及地址

fields.en: Proposed scope of work or construction
Contact person or firm that receives the returned plans
fields.zh: 接收退回图纸的联系人或公司

attach.en: Plans in PDF (floor plan, equipment, plumbing, finishes per the Retail Construction Guide)
attach.zh: PDF 图纸（按零售施工指南包含平面、设备、给排水及饰面）

attach.en: Specification sheets for equipment, ventilation, water heater and finishes
attach.zh: 设备、通风、热水器及饰面的规格表

destination.evidence: Send an email to DPH-PlanCheck_Food@ph.lacounty.gov saying you wish to submit electronic plans; you receive a SharePoint link to upload them. Do not email plans to your plan check inspector.

lac-plan-check.notes: Review starts only after the invoiced plan check fee is paid (card fee 2.22%, $1.49 minimum). Plan Check Program (626) 430-5560. The service request PDF redirects to an http address and could not be read.

attach.en: The completed application, handed to the plan checker at the final inspection
attach.zh: 填好的申请表，在最终检查时交给图纸审查员

destination.evidence: A permit application will be provided by the plan checker once construction is complete; provide it to the plan checker with the required documents at the final inspection. Do not send a payment unless you have received an invoice.

lac-health-permit.notes: Not mailed in for new facilities: it comes from and goes back to the plan checker at the final inspection. Change of ownership: the inspector takes it at the inspection. Questions: EHPermits@ph.lacounty.gov, (888) 700-9995.

sources.what: LA Department of Building and Safety home (ladbs.org now redirects here)

attach.en: Plans for plan check (ePlanLA), unless the work qualifies for an express permit (PermitLA)
attach.zh: 供审查的图纸（ePlanLA），符合快速许可条件者除外（PermitLA）

destination.evidence: Projects that need plan check are filed online in ePlanLA; simple express projects in PermitLA; both need an Angeleno account.

la-ladbs.notes: ladbs.org now redirects to dbs.lacity.gov, so the library's PDF link is dead. A temporary Certificate of Occupancy is paid online.

la-lafd-ops.form_seen: LAFD fire permit (through the Office of Finance)

fields.en: Legal name and BTRC account number
fields.zh: 法定名称及 BTRC 账号
营业地址及法定地块描述

destination.evidence: At the Office of Finance Public Counter staff prepare a Business Referral Slip; LADBS Zoning signs and stamps it; the fee is paid at the Office of Finance, which sends an Authorization Form to LAFD for inspection.

la-lafd-ops.notes: In person by appointment, not online. Renewal payments due December 31, payable online. Office of Finance: Finance.CustomerService@lacity.org, (844) 663-4411.
